string.value: Sujiu, a chat-first AI role-play client

string.name: context_sheet_empty
string.value: No context sources in this session yet.

string.name: error_turn_failed
string.value: The reply could not be completed.

string.name: error_new_chat_failed
string.value: A new chat could not be started.

string.name: error_no_provider_configured
string.value: No model service is configured yet.

string.name: error_turn_busy
string.value: A reply is already in progress.

string.name: provider_hint
string.value: Sujiu talks to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The api key is stored on this device only.

string.name: provider_explore_hint
string.value: Type an address and a key, then ask what is there. You only have to choose a model.

string.name: provider_models_more
string.value: %d in all — type a name to pick any of them

string.name: provider_listing_absent
string.value: This endpoint has no model list. That is normal for a gateway and does not mean it cannot chat, so you can still type a model name.

string.name: provider_listing_permission_denied
string.value: This key is not allowed to list models. It may still be allowed to chat, so you can still type a model name.

string.name: provider_listing_rate_limited
string.value: This endpoint is rate limiting the lookup right now. You can still type a model name.

string.name: provider_listing_unreachable
string.value: This endpoint could not be reached to list models. You can still type a model name.

string.name: provider_listing_unknown
string.value: The model list has not been looked up yet. You can type a model name.

string.name: provider_no_models
string.value: Type a model name above; the address still works.

string.name: provider_key_stored
string.value: An api key is stored on this device.

string.name: provider_need_key
string.value: Now add an API key. Nothing can be checked without one.

string.name: provider_ready
string.value: Address and key are set. Ask what this endpoint supports.

string.name: provider_probing
string.value: Asking the endpoint what it supports…

string.name: provider_models_count
string.value: Found %d models. Choose one, or type a name.

string.name: provider_listing_unavailable
string.value: Connected, but this endpoint does not list models. Type a model name — chatting still works.

string.name: provider_auth_failed
string.value: The API key was rejected. Check the key and try again.

string.name: provider_no_such_endpoint
string.value: Something answered that address, but not that path. Check the address and the path.

string.name: provider_network_error
string.value: The endpoint could not be reached. Check the network and the address.

string.name: provider_server_error
string.value: The endpoint answered with an error. It may be busy; try again shortly.

string.name: provider_rate_limited
string.value: Too many requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.

string.name: provider_no_usable_protocol
string.value: This endpoint answered, but speaks none of the protocols Sujiu knows.

string.name: provider_undetermined
string.value: Sujiu could not tell which protocols this endpoint speaks. It may still work.

string.name: provider_unreadable
string.value: The endpoint answered with something Sujiu cannot read.

string.name: provider_model_hint
string.value: This one is yours to choose. Sujiu will not pick it for you.

string.name: provider_diagnostics_copied
string.value: Log copied. It is safe to paste: keys never appear in it.

string.name: provider_diagnostics_note
string.value: API keys are never written here — a key appears only as a masked fragment.

string.name: error_provider_not_saved
string.value: The provider could not be saved.
